personas.summary: A synthetic user who needs formal wording translated into ordinary language.

personas.summary: A synthetic user who skips information until comfortable returning to it.

scenarios.title: Retain several volunteered facts
scenarios.purpose: Measure multi-fact retention, low repetition, correction safety, and post-completion review.

event.content: My legal name is Maya Patel, I was born on 9 April 1990, and I am a sole tenant.
I already gave you my date of birth with my name.

forbidden_reask_terms: what is your date of birth

event.content: I also told you my housing arrangement.
I want to change my legal name.
Give me a short final summary.

scenarios.title: Explain, simplify, and recover
scenarios.purpose: Measure adaptive explanation, focused clarification, and a smooth return to answering.

event.content: That did not answer me. What date are you asking for?

branches.visible_user_message: That did not answer me. What date are you asking for?

event.content: What choices do I have here?
Thanks, what should I do now?

scenarios.title: Handle an interrupted I-9 interview
scenarios.purpose: Measure side-question handling and resumption without losing the active I-9 field.

event.content: Does family name mean my surname?
Before we continue, what have we completed?
I need a moment. Can you remind me what you need when I come back?
I am back. It is J.
What surname did we put down?
List the status of these three questions.
Great, are we finished with this section?

scenarios.title: Correct a completed short form safely
scenarios.purpose: Measure correction and rejection while retaining other confirmed values.

event.content: I need to correct my full name.

scenarios.title: Skip and later reopen a personal question
scenarios.purpose: Measure respectful skipping, reopening, and review without pressure.

event.content: I am ready to reopen my preferred name.
Okay, leave everything as it is.

scenarios.title: Recover from frustration without pushing
scenarios.purpose: Measure empathy, adaptation, useful explanation, and return to completion.

event.content: This wording is exhausting. I do not understand it.
That still did not help. Ask the question in one simple sentence.

branches.visible_user_message: That still did not help. Ask the question in one simple sentence.

event.content: I am not sure what this box wants me to say.
My work hours were reduced, I need help buying food, and I have already asked my family but they cannot help.
Did you keep what I actually said?

confirmed_values.support_request_explanation: My work hours were reduced, I need help buying food, and I have already asked my family but they cannot help.

support_request_explanation: My work hours were reduced, I need help buying food, and I have already asked my family but they cannot help.

scenarios.title: Complete and correct a split passport date
scenarios.purpose: Measure continuity across split date fields and safe correction of one component.

event.content: Does this want the month as a number?
What parts of my birth date have we done?
I need to change the birth day.
Read the three stored date parts back to me.

scenarios.title: Distinguish startup budget and actual cost
scenarios.purpose: Measure explanation of neighbouring worksheet fields and clarification of an approximate amount.

event.content: What is the difference between budget and actual here?
Read back the budget and actual rent figures.

scenarios.title: Complete and revisit an I-9 address
scenarios.purpose: Measure conversational framing, skipping an optional detail, reopening it, and later correction.

event.content: My street address is 10 River Lane.

turns.visible_user_message: I will skip the apartment number for now.

event.content: Go back to the apartment number.
What full address information do we have?

scenarios.title: Answer detailed questions after completion
scenarios.purpose: Measure useful post-completion review from canonical state without accidental mutation.

event.content: I might change the accept terms answer.
Actually leave it unchanged and cancel.

scenarios.title: Clarify uncertain dates and amounts
scenarios.purpose: Measure focused clarification without converting uncertainty into invented precision.

event.content: I found the payslip. Change employment income.
Read those three values back clearly.

scenarios.title: Keep a spoken interview calm and concise
scenarios.purpose: Measure speech suitability, pacing, skipping, reopening, and low-effort review.

event.content: Before we start, please go slowly and keep it simple.
What date format do you need?
Let's go back to the preferred name.
Give me the short version of what we entered.

scenarios.title: Avoid asking for already supplied details
scenarios.purpose: Stress volunteered detail recall and explicit user objections to repeated questions.

event.content: My legal name is Maya Patel, call me May, and my date of birth is 9 April 1990.
I already said you can call me May.

forbidden_reask_terms: what name do you want us to use

event.content: I gave you my birth date at the start too.

forbidden_reask_terms: what is your date of birth

event.content: Did I have to repeat anything else?

scenarios.title: Answer side questions before resuming
scenarios.purpose: Measure agenda continuity when the user repeatedly interrupts with relevant questions.

event.content: Do I count myself even though I live alone?
Can you tell me the choices without choosing for me?
Summarise what I entered, not the questions.
Did you make up any of those answers?
